    StartersPan-Pacific canapésBlinis with smoked salmon and crème fraîche, cucumber cups with whipped goat's cheeseHow to make it12 blinis100ml crème fraîche100g smoked salmon1 bunch dill1 Lebanese cucumber100g goat's cheeseTop the blinis with crème fraîche, smoked salmon and dill.Cut the cucumber into thick rounds, scoop a small hollow in each and whip the goat's cheese smooth.Fill the cucumber cups with the cheese and lay everything on trays.Federation approved potato tortillaSlow cooked potato and onion folded into eggs, cut into squaresHow to make it600g potatoes1 brown onion250ml extra virgin olive oil6 eggssalt, to tasteSlice the potatoes and onion thin.Cook slowly in the olive oil until soft but not coloured.Drain, then fold into the beaten eggs and season.Cook in a pan over low heat until nearly set, flip with a plate and cook the other side. Cut into squares.Rico's paso doble patatas bravasRico shows Scott the real paso doble out the backHow to make itAs written, serves 4Crisp roast potato cubes under a smoky, spicy tomato bravas sauce and garlic aioli, finished with paprika and parsley.Cut 1kg potatoes into 3cm cubes and boil 5 minutes.Drain, toss in 60ml olive oil and salt and roast at 220°C for 40 minutes, turning once.Cook 1 diced onion and 2 garlic cloves in oil for 5 minutes, add 2 tsp smoked paprika, half a tsp cayenne and 400g crushed tomatoes and simmer 15 minutes, then blend.Mix 100g mayonnaise with 1 crushed garlic clove.Top the potatoes with both sauces and parsley.Fried chorizo with manchegoYa Ya's rhythm, felt from the heart.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsRico's backyard paellaChicken and chorizo paella with saffron rice and prawnsHow to make it600g chicken thigh pieces150g chorizo1 brown onion2 garlic cloves1 red capsicum1 tsp smoked paprika300g paella rice1 L chicken stock1 pinch saffron300g green prawnsSlice the chorizo, dice the onion and capsicum, and crush the garlic. Heat the stock with the saffron.Brown the chicken and chorizo in a wide pan.Add the onion, garlic, capsicum and paprika and cook until soft.Stir in the rice and hot stock, then cook without stirring.Push the prawns into the rice for the last 5 minutes, then rest briefly before serving.Barry Fife's status quo chickenBarry's status quo vadis, so to speakHow to make itAs written, serves 4Butter-basted chicken breasts with a creamy mushroom and thyme sauce, crunchy roast potatoes and steamed broccolini, a proper dinner dance plate.Parboil 1kg potatoes for 8 minutes, toss in oil and roast at 220°C for 45 minutes.Season 4 chicken breasts and brown in oil 4 minutes a side, add 30g butter and thyme and baste, then finish at 200°C for 10 minutes.Rest.In the same pan cook 250g sliced mushrooms and 1 shallot, add 125ml chicken stock and 150ml cream and simmer until thick.Steam 2 bunches broccolini.SweetsChurros and chocolateFried cinnamon sugar churros with a hot chocolate dipHow to make it250ml water60g butter150g plain flour2 eggs2 L vegetable oil100g caster sugar2 tsp cinnamon150g dark chocolate300ml full cream milkBoil the water with the butter, beat in the flour until a smooth dough forms, then beat in the eggs.Pipe strips into oil heated to 180°C and fry in batches until golden.Toss the churros in the sugar and cinnamon.Melt the chocolate into the hot milk for dipping.DrinksPaso doble sangriaRed wine sangria with brandy, orange juice and fruit, topped with sodaHow to make it750ml red wine60ml brandy250ml orange juice1 orange1 lemon1 apple300ml soda waterice, to serveSlice the orange, lemon and apple and mix in a jug with the wine, brandy and juice.Chill for 2 hours so the flavours come together.Top with the soda water and pour over ice.Cold horchata with cinnamonA life lived in fear is a life half lived.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
